logData: Beat the final boss and unlocked the final car!
Expected more variation in gameplay but I suppose you shouldn't mess with what works
Expected a more revolutionary experience but I suppose I should've played the game less than 14 years later if that's what I wanted
Runs well enough on the Steam Deck<^&^> would love better performance if possibe though. May actually try and use the desktop for MKB<^&^> but we'll see how I go getting used to the controls

Played on Steam Deck. Graphics look pretty good when the lighting is just right which is crazy considering it's nearly 2 decades old. Played through first 4 missions<^&^> and am starting to recognise areas from my first playthrough over a decade ago!

Game seems to freeze momentarily when opening Zoopedia<^&^> or Trading Centre but otherwise controls are getting slightly more natural and gameplay is as entrancing as always<^&^> even with the inferior controls<^&^> visuals<^&^> and performance of the Steam Deck. Losing time and loving it!
Finished the game. So sad having Sgt Johnson die.Nice clean and satisfying ending. Keen for ODST and Reach
Started building aquariums at one of the campaign zoos
Finally got the Silver star in one of the first zoos and starting moving onto the silver star at the aquarium focused zoo

Tried adding sharks to aquarium focused zoo<^&^> however got lazy<^&^> didn't make a new aquarium<^&^> and now having spacing issues. For whatever reason<^&^> the animals aren't detecting the new area escavated under their rocks (as a cave)
Doesn't run anywhere near as good as I would've expected or want. Game seems cool so far though. Tunes are pumping!
